# Luminary Technicals
> Full extended knowledge corpus available at: https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/llms-full.txt

Luminary Technicals is a multidisciplinary organization connecting digital infrastructure, technology development, research, cybersecurity, education, and public-interest initiatives across five core organs and a directly associated entity. Founded and led by AR. Abhinav Ranjan (Founder & CEO).

## Canonical Organizational Structure V2

**Luminary Technicals** is the central parent organization with exactly **5 Core Organs**:

- **Luminary Servers (POWER):** Cloud infrastructure, bare-metal servers, DNS, CDN, SSL, and high-availability hosting. (`frontend/servers.html`)
- **Luminary Developers (CREATE):** Software engineering, AI systems, progressive web apps, and the Luminary Afterverse spatial computing lab. (`frontend/developers.html`)
- **Luminary Cares (EMPOWER):** Technology education, digital literacy, mentorship, and community empowerment via Luminary Books. (`frontend/cares.html`)
- **Luminary Kits (CONNECT):** Reusable developer toolkits, APIs, SDKs, and partner web collaborations including Luminary Webs. (`frontend/kits.html`)
- **Luminary Federals (ENGAGE):** Civic technology, public affairs, governance research, and the official Luminary News platform. (`frontend/federals.html`)

**Direct Associated Entity** (top-level, separate from the 5 organs):
- **Luminary Trust:** Public-interest, philanthropic ecosystem directly associated with Luminary Technicals. Oversees the **Radhika Research Foundation**. (`frontend/trust.html`)

## Organizational Formulas
- **Internal / Master Formula:** POWER. CREATE. EMPOWER. CONNECT. ENGAGE.
- **Public Branding Formula:** BUILD. RESEARCH. SECURE. EMPOWER. CONNECT.
- **Brand Line:** Building systems. Advancing ideas. Connecting impact.

## Key Projects & Initiatives
- **AgroScan** (`frontend/agroscan.html`): Flagship AI-driven precision agricultural diagnostics. Under Revival Program 2027.
- **Luminary Afterverse** (`frontend/afterverse.html`): Spatial computing lab under Luminary Developers.
- **Luminary News** (`frontend/news.html`): Official news platform under Luminary Federals.
- **Luminary Webs / Luminary Wishes:** Web solutions under Luminary Kits.
- **Luminary Books:** Publishing initiative under Luminary Cares.
- **Luminary AI:** AI research initiative under Luminary Developers.
- **Radhika Research Foundation:** Scientific foundation under Luminary Trust.
